actions.capture_screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of a URL, inline HTML, or a saved template.
actions.capture_screenshot.props.advance: Raw fields deep-merged into the request body for any API option not exposed above (e.g. pdf.watermark, pdf.pdfa, render, request).
actions.capture_screenshot.props.deliver: How the generated file is returned
Cloud Storage (upload to a presigned URL)
Webhook (deliver the file to a URL)
actions.capture_screenshot.props.deviceP: Device pixel ratio, e.g. 2 for retina (0 to 10).
actions.capture_screenshot.props.outputE: Return the image as a file (default) or as a base64 string.
Base64 (return the image as a base64 string)
Binary file (write the image to a file)
actions.capture_screenshot.props.presign: HTTP PUT presigned URL from your storage provider (required for Cloud Storage delivery).
The URL, inline HTML, or saved template ID, matching the Source Type above.
actions.capture_screenshot.props.sourceT: Template (render a saved PolyDoc template by ID)
actions.capture_screenshot.props.tag.des: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 characters).
actions.capture_screenshot.props.templat: Data passed to the Liquid template renderer (used only when Source Type is Template).
actions.capture_screenshot.props.webhook: Extra webhook settings merged with the URL: async, method, headers, retries, retryDelay, timeout.
URL the generated file is delivered to (required for Webhook delivery).

actions.convert_to_pdf.props.deliveryMod: How the generated file is returned
Cloud Storage (upload to a presigned URL)
Webhook (deliver the file to a URL)
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.marginTop.d: Top margin with optional unit, e.g. 10mm, 1cm, 0.5in.
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.outline.des: Generate PDF bookmarks from HTML headings.

actions.convert_to_pdf.props.presignedUr: HTTP PUT presigned URL from your storage provider (required for Cloud Storage delivery).
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.source.desc: The URL, inline HTML, or saved template ID, matching the Source Type above.
Template (render a saved PolyDoc template by ID)
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.tag.descrip: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 characters).
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.templateDat: Data passed to the Liquid template renderer (used only when Source Type is Template).
actions.convert_to_pdf.props.webhookOpti: Extra webhook settings merged with the URL: async, method, headers, retries, retryDelay, timeout.
URL the generated file is delivered to (required for Webhook delivery).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.generate_einvoice.description: Generate a hybrid e-invoice PDF (Factur-X / ZUGFeRD, EN 16931) from a visual layout plus structured invoice data.
actions.generate_einvoice.props.advanced: Raw fields deep-merged into the request body for any API option not exposed above (e.g. pdf.watermark, pdf.pdfa, render, request).
actions.generate_einvoice.props.delivery: How the generated file is returned
Cloud Storage (upload to a presigned URL)
Webhook (deliver the file to a URL)
Structured invoice data: number, dates, currency, seller, buyer, lines, totals. EN 16931 needs payment terms (or due date), seller taxId for VAT category S, and consistent totals. See docs.polydoc.tech.
actions.generate_einvoice.props.presigne: HTTP PUT presigned URL from your storage provider (required for Cloud Storage delivery).
The data granularity profile to validate against.
actions.generate_einvoice.props.source.d: The URL, inline HTML, or saved template ID, matching the Source Type above.
actions.generate_einvoice.props.sourceTy: Template (render a saved PolyDoc template by ID)
actions.generate_einvoice.props.standard: The hybrid e-invoice standard to embed.
actions.generate_einvoice.props.tag.desc: Label for logging and analytics (max 30 characters).
actions.generate_einvoice.props.template: Data passed to the Liquid template renderer (used only when Source Type is Template).
actions.generate_einvoice.props.verify.d: Validate PDF/A and e-invoice compliance (returns an error if it fails).
actions.generate_einvoice.props.webhookO: Extra webhook settings merged with the URL: async, method, headers, retries, retryDelay, timeout.
actions.generate_einvoice.props.webhookU: URL the generated file is delivered to (required for Webhook delivery).
auth.description:
Get an API key from the PolyDoc dashboard (dashboard.polydoc.tech, API Keys). It is sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

Turn on **Sandbox** to test against sandbox quota (output is watermarked). Leave it off for production conversions.
